title: East Insurance Group: a fair price for a fragile traffic base
subject: US insurance-guides website, sold on Flippa (listing 11356430)
price_note: The sold price is hidden, so the price below is my estimate.
notes: Price is in range: 2.3x profit sits between comparable listings (2.9x and 0.3x).
Income is probably concentrated: about $636 per 1,000 views is far above display-ad income, so revenue is likely lead sales to a few partners.
Traffic is the weak point: the listing admits a Google update hurt the site.

flags.why: Single traffic source; a core update already hurt it
Revenue per view implies few payers
Insurance guides are easy for AI answers to summarise
